en: Hello, we need a repair visit on the {system} system on {field}. Please tell us your first free day and a price. The lines must be flushed by {flush_date}.
mt: Bonjour, nous avons besoin d'une visite de réparation sur le système {system} sur {field}. S'il vous plaît dites-nous votre premier jour libre et un prix.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {system} {field} {flush_date}

en: Hello, the pump at {name} ({pump_kw} kW) is due for service on {pump_service}. Please book a visit and send a price for oil, seals and a motor check.
mt: Bonjour, la pompe de 1 kW doit être mise en service le 2 et vous pouvez réserver une visite et nous envoyer un prix pour l'huile, les joints et une vérification du moteur.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {name} {pump_kw} {pump_service}

en: Hello, we need the soil test results for {field} before we finish the fertiliser plan. The last test was on {soil_test_on}. Please send them as soon as you can.
mt: Bonjour, nous avons besoin des résultats des tests de sol pour {field} avant de terminer le plan d'engrais.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {field} {soil_test_on}

en: Hello, we plan {n_ha} kg of nitrogen per hectare for {field} ({crop}). Do you advise two or three doses? We have applied {n_done} kg per ha so far.
mt: Bonjour, nous prévoyons {n_ha} kg d'azote par hectare pour {field} ({crop}). Vous conseillez deux ou trois doses ?
why: placeholders must be exactly: {n_ha} {field} {crop} {n_done}

en: Hello {operator}, we spread {kind} on {field} on {date}: {tonnes} tonnes, {n_ha} kg of nitrogen per hectare. Please keep clear of streams, wells and the boundary strip.
mt: Bonjour, nous avons distribué 1 tonne, 5 kg d'azote par hectare, veuillez éviter les ruisseaux, les puits et la bande de délimitation.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {operator} {kind} {field} {date} {tonnes} {n_ha}

en: Hello {neighbour}, we plan to take our turn from {name} this week. Please tell us when you take yours so that we do not both open the gate.
mt: Bonjour, nous prévoyons de prendre notre tour à partir de cette semaine. S'il vous plaît dites-nous quand vous prenez le vôtre de sorte que nous n'ouvrons pas tous les deux la porte.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {neighbour} {name}

en: So far fertiliser and manure have put on {col:fertplan.n_done} kg of nitrogen per hectare, which is {col:fertplan.n_share} of the plan. The plan check shows: {col:fertplan.state}. The nitrogen balance against what the crop removes is {col:fertplan.n_bal} kg per hectare.
mt: Jusqu'à présent, l'engrais et le fumier ont ajouté {col:fertplan.n_done} kg d'azote par hectare, ce qui est {col:fertplan.n_share} du plan.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:fertplan.n_done} {col:fertplan.n_share} {col:fertplan.state} {col:fertplan.n_bal}

en: To {col:orders.supplier}. Order number: {col:orders.ord_id}, placed on {col:orders.order_date}.
mt: Numéro de commande: {col:orders.ord_id}, placé sur {col:orders.order_date}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:orders.supplier} {col:orders.ord_id} {col:orders.order_date}

en: We order {col:orders.qty_ordered} {col:orders.unit} of {col:orders.item} at {col:orders.price} per {col:orders.unit}. The order value is {col:orders.value}.

why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:orders.qty_ordered} {col:orders.unit} {col:orders.item} {col:orders.price} {col:orders.unit} {col:orders.value}

en: Please deliver on {col:orders.promised}. Send the delivery note with the batch or lot number and the weight, and tell us before the delivery if you cannot keep the date. The status of the order is {col:orders.status}.
mt: Veuillez nous envoyer le bon de livraison avec le numéro du lot ou du lot et le poids, et dites-nous avant la livraison si vous ne pouvez pas respecter la date.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:orders.promised} {col:orders.status}

en: The field is watered from {col:irrsched.source}, which delivers {col:irrsched.flow} cubic metres per hour. Each turn applies {col:irrsched.depth_mm} mm, which is {col:irrsched.m3_turn} cubic metres and {col:irrsched.hours_turn} hours of pumping, every {col:irrsched.interval} days.
mt: Le champ est arrosé à partir de {col:irrsched.source}, ce qui fournit {col:irrsched.flow} mètres cubes par heure.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:irrsched.source} {col:irrsched.flow} {col:irrsched.depth_mm} {col:irrsched.m3_turn} {col:irrsched.hours_turn} {col:irrsched.interval}

en: The last run was on {col:irrsched.last_run}. The next turn is on {col:irrsched.next_due}, in {col:irrsched.days_to} days. The turn check shows: {col:irrsched.state}. Water due this week: {col:irrsched.m3_week} cubic metres.
mt: La dernière course a eu lieu le {col:irrsched.last_run}. Le prochain tour aura lieu le {col:irrsched.next_due}, dans {col:irrsched.days_to} jours. La vérification du tour montre: {col:irrsched.state}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:irrsched.last_run} {col:irrsched.next_due} {col:irrsched.days_to} {col:irrsched.state} {col:irrsched.m3_week}

en: The supervisor writes the hours run and any fault in the irrigation log the same day. The lines are flushed on {col:irrsched.flush_date}.
mt: Le superviseur enregistre les heures écoulées et toute défaillance dans le journal d'irrigation le même jour.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:irrsched.flush_date}

en: The source delivers {col:water.flow_m3h} cubic metres per hour and serves {col:water.served_ha} hectares. The yearly quota is {col:water.quota_m3} cubic metres. This season we have used {col:water.used_m3} cubic metres, which is {col:water.share} of the quota. The quota check shows: {col:water.quota_state}.
mt: La source fournit {col:water.flow_m3h} mètres cubes par heure et dessert {col:water.served_ha} hectares. Le quota annuel est {col:water.quota_m3} mètres cubes. Cette saison, nous avons utilisé {col:water.used_m3} mètres cubes, ce qui est {col:water.share} du quota.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:water.flow_m3h} {col:water.served_ha} {col:water.quota_m3} {col:water.used_m3} {col:water.share} {col:water.quota_state}

why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:quotes.item} {col:quotes.qty} {col:quotes.list_price}

en: {col:quotes.vendor} quoted {col:quotes.price} per unit with {col:quotes.transport} for transport, a landed price of {col:quotes.landed} and a total of {col:quotes.total}. The lead time is {col:quotes.lead_days} days and the quote is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}.
mt: {col:quotes.vendor} est coté {col:quotes.price} par unité avec {col:quotes.transport} pour le transport, un prix débarqué de {col:quotes.landed} et un total de {col:quotes.total}.

en: The quote ranks number {col:quotes.rank}. The best landed price for this input is {col:quotes.best}. Choosing this quote instead of the best one costs {col:quotes.extra} more. The quote check shows: {col:quotes.state}.
mt: Le meilleur prix pour cette entrée est {col:quotes.best}. Choisir ce devis au lieu du meilleur coûte {col:quotes.extra} plus cher. Le contrôle de devis montre: {col:quotes.state}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:quotes.rank} {col:quotes.best} {col:quotes.extra} {col:quotes.state}

en: The batch was received on {col:chem.received} and expires on {col:chem.expiry}, which is in {col:chem.days_to_expiry} days. The quantity in the store is {col:chem.qty} {col:chem.unit}, worth {col:chem.value}. The expiry check shows: {col:chem.state}.

en: The storekeeper is {col:chem.keeper}. Expired products are kept apart and labelled, and are returned to the supplier or handed to an approved collector. They are never used and never poured away.

why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:chem.keeper}

why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:items.price} {col:items.unit} {col:items.prev_price} {col:items.change} {col:items.state}
